audit.whatIsWrong: Text treats the lane as a straight poke mirror Quinn wins on autos, and calls Mel 'he' throughout.
audit.why: Quinn is 54.55% over 308 games at Emerald+ — a real but modest edge, and it comes from Mel having no dash, not from out-poking her. Difficulty 6/10 and EVEN are defensible; the reason given was not.
audit.corrected: Kept EVEN / 6/10. Reframed: Quinn wins because Mel is dashless and dies to Vault + W chase; she wins by rooting with Solar Snare (E) and eating burst on Rebuttal (W).

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart in both layers disagreed with the packet chart and with the audited mirror (quinn rows read Skill, Quinn, Quinn, Skill, Skill, Quinn, Quinn).
audit.why: Packet chart and the already-audited mel side both read Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Mel, Skill, Quinn. Mel owns 6 (Rebuttal + Golden Eclipse); Quinn only clearly owns 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 4 and 5 re-proposed as one atomic group across both layers to match the packet and the mirror.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers attribute the reflect to Mel's R. The reflect is Rebuttal (W). Golden Eclipse (R) is the global Overwhelm detonation. Text also claims the Q blind stops Solar Snare.
audit.why: Riot text: Rebuttal (W) 'forms a barrier ... that reflects enemy projectiles back at the attacker, prevents her from taking damage', cd 38/35/33/29/26. Golden Eclipse strikes all Overwhelm-marked enemies at 25000 range, cd 120/100/80. Blinding Assault blinds basic attacks; it cannot stop an ability cast.
audit.corrected: Reflect reassigned to Rebuttal (W) with its 38/35/33/29/26s cooldown everywhere. Golden Eclipse restated as a global Overwhelm execute. Blind restated as an answer to her autos, not Solar Snare. Added the missing interaction: Solar Snare (E) root cancels the Behind Enemy Lines channel — channel only once her root is spent. Added Searing Brilliance (P) as the burst tell: an ability cast loads up to nine bonus projectiles on her next attack.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown block named only Solar Snare.
audit.why: Rebuttal at 38s rank 1 is the single most punishable cooldown in the matchup — it is the window Quinn's all-in exists inside.
audit.corrected: Rebuttal's cooldown added as the commit trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer mentioned that Quinn's ultimate channel is cancellable by her root.
audit.why: Behind Enemy Lines is flagged channel/interruptible; Solar Snare is hardCC.

edits.after: Mel's spike, not yours — Rebuttal (W) reflects your Vault-in burst and Golden Eclipse detonates Overwhelm, so never all-in into an up W.

edits.after: Lethality/crit (Youmuu's, Collector) plus your Q blind walk her down once Rebuttal is spent — 38s at rank 1, 26s at 5.

edits.before: Your gank-and-kill window: Mel is a squishy immobile mage with no dash, so E + W chase runs her down before she can W-zone away.
edits.after: Your gank-and-kill window: Mel has no dash, so Vault (E) plus the W move speed runs her down the moment Rebuttal's barrier drops.

edits.before: Mel pokes with a slow ranged Q, same as your Blinding Assault birds, so this is a poke mirror you win on the auto-attacks she can't match. Don't just sit in her Q range trading skillshots — weave in Harrier-marked autos with your W attack-speed steroid up, because your reset burst out-damages her single Q tick. Her Q is a slow projectile; sidestep it the way you'd want her to miss yours, and only throw your own Q to blind when she's actually auto-ing you, since the blind does nothing to her abilities.
edits.after: Mel pokes with Radiant Volley (Q), same as your Blinding Assault birds, so this is a poke mirror you win on the auto-attacks she can't match. Don't sit at her 950 range trading skillshots — weave in Harrier-marked autos with your W steroid up, because your reset burst out-damages one Volley tick. Sidestep the way you'd want her to miss yours, and throw Blinding Assault only when she is actually auto-ing you, since the blind does nothing to Solar Snare or Radiant Volley.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay a skill lane — land more autos than she lands Qs and you pull ahead. Level 6 is HER window, not yours: Mel's R reflects incoming damage and projectiles, so if you E in and dump a Harrier auto into an up Overwhelm you hand her the trade and your own burst back. Respect that cooldown — bait the reflect or wait it out, then commit. Use your own R to roam and make plates/picks happen rather than to duel her, because direct trading here is even.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay a skill lane — land more autos than she lands Volleys and you pull ahead. Level 6 is HER window, not yours: Rebuttal (W) blocks damage and reflects projectiles, so if you Vault in and dump a Harrier auto into an up barrier you hand her the trade and your own burst back. Bait it or wait its 38/35/33/29/26 seconds out, then commit. Golden Eclipse then detonates every Overwhelm stack on you from anywhere on the map, so never sit low with stacks. Use your own R to roam, not to duel her.

edits.before: Past first item you reclaim it. Mel is a squishy immobile mage with no dash, and Quinn is exactly the champion that erases that — E onto her, W for the chase steroid, and your blind shuts off nothing because she has no escape from your reset autos. The only thing that flips it is her R: don't dive into an up reflect and don't get clipped by her W-zone or E-execute when you're low. Use your roam ult to catch her isolated and the lane is yours.
edits.after: Past first item you reclaim it. Mel is a squishy mage with no dash, and Quinn is exactly the champion that erases that — Vault onto her, W for the chase steroid, and she has no escape from your reset autos. The only thing that flips it is Rebuttal: don't dive into an up barrier, and don't linger in Solar Snare's slow zone while Overwhelm stacks sit on you, because Golden Eclipse fires from anywhere. Track her W — 38s at rank 1, 26s at rank 5 — and catch her isolated with your roam ult.

notes: MAJOR FACTUAL FIX: both layers credited the reflect to Mel's R. The reflect is Rebuttal (W), 38/35/33/29/26s; Golden Eclipse (R) is the global Overwhelm detonation at 25000 range, 120/100/80s. Also fixed pronouns — the full layer called Mel 'he' throughout. UNVERIFIED, LEFT ALONE (matches the mel-side auditor's note): whether Rebuttal reflects Quinn's basic attacks. Riot text says 'enemy projectiles' without defining basic attacks; the kit needsResearch block is empty, so I neither asserted nor removed it — my rewrites say 'reflects projectiles' and route the warning through burst, not autos specifically.
